# MINT SUIT

> MINT SUIT is a music project. Sublime, a seven-track EP recorded between
> 2018 and 2024, was released on August 22, 2026. This site is the official
> home of the record: https://mintsuit.com/

MINT SUIT makes music as a hobby. There is no schedule behind it and nothing
to keep up with — tracks get finished when they get finished, which is why
there are not many of them. There have been songs since 2013, uploaded back
then under a different artist name; most of them are gone, because the sites
that hosted them shut down and nobody kept copies.

Genres: R&B/Soul, Experimental, Plunderphonic, Pop, Vaporwave.

## Sublime (EP, 2026)

Sublime follows the journey of a night filled with attraction and romance.
From the very first touch in "Sex & Velvet" to the unforgettable high of
"Divine", each track is a chapter of mystery, style, and a pure connection.

1. Sex & Velvet (3:15): https://mintsuit.bandcamp.com/track/sex-velvet
2. Hungry Lips (3:27): https://mintsuit.bandcamp.com/track/hungry-lips-2
3. Y2Ks Eyes (3:20): https://mintsuit.bandcamp.com/track/y2ks-eyes
4. Redamancy (3:40): https://mintsuit.bandcamp.com/track/redamancy
5. Pick You Up At 8 (4:07): https://mintsuit.bandcamp.com/track/pick-you-up-at-8
6. DEMO #01 (6:00): https://mintsuit.bandcamp.com/track/sublime-experience-demo-01
7. Divine (1:18): https://mintsuit.bandcamp.com/track/divine
